explanation: Vasari's story says he overheard visitors crediting it to another sculptor, so he carved his name on the sash across Mary's chest. He was in his early twenties.

claims.text: The Pietà in St Peter's Basilica is the only work Michelangelo signed.
Michelangelo did not sign David, Moses or the Sistine Chapel ceiling.
According to Vasari, Michelangelo signed the Pietà after hearing visitors attribute it to another sculptor.
Michelangelo's signature on the Pietà is carved on the sash across the Virgin Mary's chest.
Michelangelo carved the Pietà in 1498 and 1499, when he was in his early twenties.
